subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Employee Appreciation Day!
body: Dear Team, I am excited to announce our upcoming Annual Employee Appreciation Day event! It will be held on Friday, October 15th at the local park from 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM. We have planned fun activities, food, and prizes to celebrate your hard work and dedication. Please RSVP by October 8th. We look forward to seeing you all there! Best regards, [Your Name]
